# Namibia

Values for an OG-Core calibration, then the estimates behind them. How to use them: [calibration guide](../calibration-guide.md).

## Values for OG-Core

| OG-Core input | Wealth gradient | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `fert_gradient` | −1.05, by age as below | DHS 2013, TFR, plus [age offsets](../methods/fertility-by-age.md) |
| `infmort_gradient` | −0.94 | DHS 2013, infant mortality rate |
| `mort_gradient` | −1.02 (95% prediction interval −1.73 to −0.31) | [general gradient](../methods/general-gradient.md) at GDP per capita (PPP, constant 2021 international $) of $10,242 (2025, World Bank) |
| `imm_pctiles` | not provided | — |
